user.title: House Chime
user.description: Create the announcement control integration. House Chime discovers Home Assistant people, playback zones, helpers, and approved media paths, then plays announcements through Music Assistant.

data_description.name: The display name for this House Chime installation.

missing_media.title: Announcement media is missing
missing_media.description: House Chime could not find a configured media asset for `{event_id}`. Check the configured media path in House Chime options and confirm the file exists in Home Assistant local media. Error: `{error}`

no_target_zones.title: No announcement zones are selected
no_target_zones.description: House Chime resolved `{event_id}`, but no playable target zones remained after selected-zone and quiet-zone rules were applied. Select at least one available playback zone in House Chime options. Error: `{error}`

missing_music_assistant_service.title: Music Assistant announcement service is missing
missing_music_assistant_service.description: House Chime requires `music_assistant.play_announcement` for playback. Install or enable Music Assistant before using House Chime playback services. Error: `{error}`

init.title: House Chime options
init.description: Configure people, zones, quiet hours, events, voices, and media paths from Home Assistant.

people.title: People and priority
people.description: Select the people House Chime should consider and order them by priority. The first selected person who is home becomes the active household context.

data_description.priority_order: Comma-separated person IDs in priority order, for example: david, scarlett, juliette.
data_description.default_context_id: The context to use when no selected person is home.

zones.title: Playback zones
zones.description: Select the Music Assistant or media player zones used for announcements. Quiet-excluded zones are removed from playback during the quiet-zone window.

quiet.title: Quiet mode
quiet.description: Configure the global quiet window and quiet-zone window.

data_description.volume_multiplier: Volume multiplier during quiet hours. 0.5 means 50 percent of the normal announcement volume.
data_description.zone_start: Optional quiet-zone start time in 24-hour HH:MM format.
data_description.zone_end: Optional quiet-zone end time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

events.title: Events and trigger sounds
events.description: Enable each event, pick default voices, assign optional person-specific voices, configure common trigger sounds, and choose bridge helpers.

voice_media.title: Voice media
voice_media.description: Map each voice personality to approved local-media MP3 files for each event. Use media-source://media_source/local/... paths.
